Our current draft includes an audience-voting segment, a volunteer performance, and a headliner appearance for Saturday evening's live showcase. Before I can approve anything, I need the digital, labor, and artist teams to report any constraints that might affect the final format. What do we need to work around?

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint on the audience-voting segment. I reviewed the voting platform's updated terms during this morning's setup, and the platform cannot collect audience phone numbers. Voting must use anonymous QR tokens instead, and we'll need to update the audience-facing privacy notice accordingly. I haven't added this to the show brief yet because the vendor posted the update after the brief was circulated.

I hadn't entered this on the production board yet because the volunteer segment was still marked as provisional.
